FormModule.Name: EDIMSG1120
FormModule.Title: EDIMSG1120_CENTRL
FormModule.Comment:
*******************************************************************

FORMS MODULE NAME
 EDIMSG1120

MODIFIED
 APPDEV248 19/08/26 12:48 created by Form Generator for
 Form Builder Version 6.0.3.11.0

Repository APPLICATION SYSTEM
 EDI_MESSAGES Version 1

PURPOSE
 إرسال ومتابعة الرسائل داخل الجمرك

MODULE DESCRIPTION
.
The following definition will be used :
-----------------------------------------
1-The message header(MSG_HDR) is created by the business module and it will be referred as "message".
2-The message owner (MSG_OWNER) is created by the business module and will be referred as "owner".
3-The message actions.(MSG_ACTN) is created whenever an action is taken on the message and will be referred as action.
4-When the word "user" appears in the text it means the "user id" or the user class "class_cd".
The only exception where user means user id are:
-The message creator in "MSG_HDR"
-The "send to" in "MSG_ACTN"

General Rules:
--------------
1-The user can work only on enabled document types & message types.
2-The followings are passed to the report at setup(the user will not enter them) :
 The document type (ex.: 0 for all،1for manifest , 2 for IS))
 The message direction (equals 1 in this case"Internal")

Screen:
-------
The user will see the screen as 2 parts:
1-The first part will contain the message header information and the owner information,
 he can query the details by pressing a button.
2-The second part will contain the actions taken on the message
3-He can scroll in the 2 parts

Rules for querying the messages:
--------------------------------
The user can query the messages, message details, owners, and actions in the following cases:
1-Created by him (through the business module)
2-Owned by him (his name or class are in "MSG_OWNER" ).
3-Owned by many users (his name or class are in the list of "MSG_OWNER" )
4-Owned by anonymous (no owner(no instances in "MSG_OWNER" ).

The user can query the messages, message details, owners, and ONLY the actions that he is a part of it :
1-Forwarded to him (he is the destination )
6-Replied by him
7-Sent by him

From the queried messages and actions, the user can perform actions according to the followings:
==============================================================================
SEND "إرسال"
Transferring the ownership of a message to another user
--------------------------------------------------------
 IF(the current user is the owner AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing") AND (no actions found OR "send" actions found))
 {
 DELETE all instances in MSG_OWNER
 INSERT an instance with his name in MSG_OWNER // for recalling purpose
 INSERT an instance with the destination user in MSG_OWNER
 INSERT a “send action” in MSG_ACTN with his name as a "sender from" and the destination user as a "send to"
 IF (the message was sent to him by another user i.e. an instance in
 MSG_ACTN exists with his name as a destination )
 {
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "send" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }
 IF(msg_status="new") change it to "under processing"
 }

=====================================================================================
Forward "تحويل لعمل اللازم"
forward the message to the intended business unit
-------------------------------------------------
IF(the current user is the owner AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing"))
 {
 INSERT a “forward action” in MSG_ACTN with his name as a "sender from" and the destination user as a "send to"
 IF (the message was sent to him by another user i.e. an instance in
 MSG_ACTN exists with the owner user as a destination )
 {
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "forward" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }
 IF(msg_status="new") change it to "under processing"
 }
=====================================================================================
Reply "إجابة"
Reply to forwarded action
---------------------------
IF( (a "forward" action exists with "send to"=current user) AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing") )
 {
 INSERT a “reply action” in MSG_ACTN with "sender from"=current user & "send to"= the "send from" of the found "forward" action
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "reply" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }
=====================================================================================
Recall "إعادة"
Reacll the message before the destination user takes actions
------------------------------------------------------------
IF( an action exists with "send from"=current user) AND (no successor action exists) AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing") ))
 {
 IF (the recalled action was "send")
 {
 DELETE all instances in MSG_OWNER
 INSERT an instance with his name in MSG_OWNER
 INSERT a “recall action” in MSG_ACTN with sender from"=current user & "send to"= current user
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "reply" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }

 IF (the recalled action was "forward" OR "reply")
 {
 INSERT a “recall action” in MSG_ACTN with the destination user=his name
 INSERT a “recall action” in MSG_ACTN with sender from"=current user & "send to"= current user
 UPDATE the successor of the inserted "reply" action instant in "MSG_ACTN " with the predecessor action
 }
 }
=====================================================================================
Approve/Reject the message "تم تنفيذ المطلوب في الرسالة\رفضه"
--------------------------------------------
IF(the current user is the owner AND (message status is "new" OR "under processing") AND all "forward" actions are replyed)
 {
 INSERT a “completed action” in MSG_ACTN with no successor
 Chang the message status to Approved/rejected and write free text
 }
=====================================================================================
Approve/Reject and message notifid "تم تنفيذ المطلوب في الرسالة\رفضه وتم إعلام منشأ الرسالة"
-----------------------------------------------------------------
//This can be done from this screen or automatically from th Business module
IF(current user= message creator AND message status is approved/rejected)
 {
 Chang the message status to Approved&notified/rejected&notified and write free text
 }
=====================================================================================

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 HDATE DATE;
BEGIN
 IF :System.TRIGGER_ITEM = :System.CURSOR_ITEM THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Value IS NOT NULL THEN
 HDATE := TO_DATE(:System.Cursor_Value);

 IF NOT HIJDATE.VALID_HIJ_DATE(HDATE) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 BELL;
 COMMIT;

 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) AND :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'QUERY' THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

 :title.user_name := :PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME;
 :title.SCREEN_NAME := :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME;
 :title.SYSTEM_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET VARCHAR2(10);
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

IF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 2 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPAlert('يجب ادخال بنود للتعهد او حذف التعهد','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

ELSIF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 0 THEN
 PROP := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SAVE',VISIBLE);

 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(-1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');
 Execute_Function('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := FALSE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 0;
END IF;
END;

/* Clear dependent items, if this item is null. */
/* This clears all items associated with the given foreign key. */
BEGIN

 IF (:MSG_HDRS.STATS_ISN IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :MSG_HDRS.STATS_ISN := NULL;
 END IF;
 IF (:MSG_HDRS.STATS_NBR IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :MSG_HDRS.STATS_NBR := NULL;
 END IF;
 IF (:MSG_HDRS.STATS_DT IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :MSG_HDRS.STATS_DT := NULL;
 END IF;
 IF (:MSG_HDRS.STATS_TYPE_CD IS NOT NULL) THEN
 :MSG_HDRS.STATS_TYPE_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
END;
/* CGFK$VALDIDATE_FK_OVF */
/* Check that foreign key value exists in referenced table */
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('MSG_HDRS.STATS_NBR') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$LKP_MSG_HDRS_MHDR_SD_FK(
 TRUE /* IN : Is the trigger item level? */
 ,:MSG_HDRS.STATS_TYPE_CD /* MOD: Value in Item :MSG_HDRS.STATS_TYPE_CD. */
 ,:MSG_HDRS.STATS_DT /* MOD: Value in Item :MSG_HDRS.STATS_DT. */
 ,:MSG_HDRS.STATS_ISN /* MOD: Value in Item :MSG_HDRS.STATS_ISN. */
 ,:MSG_HDRS.PORT_CD ); /* MOD: Value in Item :MSG_HDRS.PORT_CD. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('الرجاء التأكد من بيانات البيان المدخلة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'MHDR_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'منشــأ الرسالة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MHDR_SD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('الرجاء التأكد من بيانات البيان المدخلة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MHDR_SDP_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'RECV_MSG_PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MHDR_PC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('الرجاء التأكد من بيانات متعهد التفريغ المدخلة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MHDR_MT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع المستند,نوع الرسالة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MHDR_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('الرجاء التأكد من بيانات البيان المدخلة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('MSG_HDRS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$EDIMSG1120_CENTRL_GLOBALS.MSG_HDRS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$EDIMSG1120_CENTRL_GLOBALS.MSG_HDRS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$EDIMSG1120_CENTRL_GLOBALS.MSG_HDRS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('MSG_HDRS.STATS_NBR');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(STATS_NBR '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(STATS_NBR '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(to_char(STATS_NBR) LIKE '''|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(STATS_NBR ='|| r_string || ')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 r_string := NAME_IN('MSG_HDRS.STATS_DT');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(STATS_DT '|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(STATS_DT '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(to_char(STATS_DT,''MI-MM-RRRR'') LIKE '''|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(STATS_DT ='''|| r_string || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((PORT_CD, nvl(to_char(STATS_ISN), ''CG$NULL'')) IN '||'(SELECT PORT_CD, nvl(to_char(STATS_ISN), ''CG$NULL'') '||'FROM STATS_DCLTNS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('MSG_HDRS.DCLTN_NBR');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_NBR '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_NBR '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(to_char(DCLTN_NBR) LIKE '''|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_NBR ='|| r_string || ')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 r_string := NAME_IN('MSG_HDRS.DCLTN_DT');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_DT '|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_DT '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(to_char(DCLTN_DT,''MI-MM-RRRR'') LIKE '''|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_DT ='''|| r_string || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(DCLTN_ISN), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(DCLTN_ISN), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD '||'FROM DECLARATIONS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 timer_id Timer;
 ONE_SECOND NUMBER(5):= 100;
 V_GET_FUN_CODE NUMBER(2);
BEGIN
IF :GLOBAL.EDIMSGREQ = 1 AND :MSG_STAT = 7 AND
:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA')) THEN
 V_GET_FUN_CODE := SEA_SHPMT_WRAPPER.writeMafStsMsg(
 NULL,
 :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID,
 NULL,
 :RESPONSE_FREE_TEXT,
 :MSG_HDRS.PORT_CD,
 :MFST_TYPE,
 :MFST_NBR,
 :MFST_DT
 );
 IF V_GET_FUN_CODE > 0 THEN
 --success
 :GLOBAL.EDIMSGREQ := 0;
 ELSE

--failure
 STR.DISPALERT('حدث خطأ في عملية التحويل إلى الطلب الإلحاقي, الرجاء مراجعة المساندة الفنية','ERROR');
 :GLOBAL.EDIMSGREQ := 0;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

END IF;

timer_id:=CREATE_TIMER('OWNERS_Q2',ONE_SECOND,NO_REPEAT);

END;

:PARAMETER.P_LEVEL := 1;

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_SEQ NUMBER(2);
 V_OWNER_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :MSG_STAT = 1 THEN
 :MSG_STAT := 2 ;
 UPDATE MSG_HDRS SET MSG_STAT = 2 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID;
END IF;
---
IF NVL(:MSG_DIRECTION,0) <> 1 THEN
 :MSG_DIRECTION := 1;
 UPDATE MSG_HDRS SET MSG_DIRECTION = 1 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID;
END IF;
--------------------------------------------
IF :GLOBAL.APP_REJ = 0 THEN
CHECK_FOR_SEDI_MQ_MSGS;
 :MSG_STAT := 3 ;
 :RESPONSE_FREE_TEXT := :FREE_TEXT;
 UPDATE MSG_HDRS
 SET MSG_STAT = 3 , RESPONSE_FREE_TEXT=:FREE_TEXT
 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID;

ELSIF :GLOBAL.APP_REJ = 1 THEN
CHECK_FOR_SEDI_MQ_MSGS;
 :MSG_STAT := 4 ;
 :RESPONSE_FREE_TEXT := :FREE_TEXT;
 UPDATE MSG_HDRS
 SET MSG_STAT = 4 , RESPONSE_FREE_TEXT=:FREE_TEXT
 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID;
ELSE
 NULL;
END IF;
------

IF :MSG_STAT IN (3,4,7) OR :GLOBAL.APP_REJ IN (0,1)THEN

 DELETE FROM MSG_OWNERS
 WHERE MSG_ID =:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID;

 SELECT NVL(MAX(OWNER_SEQ),0) + 1
 INTO V_SEQ
 FROM MSG_OWNERS
 WHERE NVL(MSG_ID, '1') = NVL(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID, '1');


INSERT INTO MSG_OWNERS VALUES
 (:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID,V_SEQ,NULL,NULL,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,:MSG_HDRS.PORT_CD,
 :MSG_HDRS.DOC_TYPE2,:MSG_HDRS.MSG_TYPE2);
FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END IF;

-----------------------------------------------
 IF ( (:ACTN_TYPE_CD = 1 OR (:ACTN_TYPE_CD = 2 AND OWNER_CHECK(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID)= 1 ) ) OR
 (:ACTN_TYPE_CD = 4 AND :GLOBAL.ACT_TYPE_CD = 1)
 ) THEN

 DELETE FROM MSG_OWNERS WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID;

 SELECT NVL(MAX(OWNER_SEQ),0) + 1
 INTO V_SEQ
 FROM MSG_OWNERS
 WHERE NVL(MSG_ID, '1') = NVL(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID, '1');

 INSERT INTO MSG_OWNERS VALUES(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID,
 V_SEQ,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,
 :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,
 :DOC_TYPE2,
 :MSG_TYPE2);
 :GLOBAL.ACT_TYPE_CD := 0;
 IF :ACTN_TYPE_CD = 1 THEN

 INSERT INTO MSG_OWNERS VALUES (:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID,
 V_SEQ+1,
 :CLASS_CD_TO,
 :USR_TYPE_CD_TO,
 :USER_ID_TO,
 :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,
 :DOC_TYPE2,
 :MSG_TYPE2);
 END IF;
---------------------------------
 END IF;
 :ACTN_TIME:=SYSDATE;
 :MSG_ACTNS.PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD;

--------------------------------

END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'MACTN_USR_TO_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', ' إلــى' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MACTN_USR_FROM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'المستخــدم .' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MACTN_SC_USR_CLS_TO_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', '/تصنيف,أو إلى نوع' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MACTN_MHDR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'مسلسل الرسالة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'MACTN_MACTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'يتبع' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Msg Actns','Msg Hdrs' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Msg Actns','Msg Hdrs' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
V_ACT_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :ACTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (5,7) THEN
IF (
 (:USER_ID_TO IS NOT NULL AND :USR_TYPE_CD_TO IS NOT NULL)
 OR(:USER_ID_TO IS NULL AND :USR_TYPE_CD_TO IS NULL)
 ) AND :ACTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (3,4)THEN

 STR.DISPALERT('يجب إدخال أحد الحقول ( المرسل إليه أو حقل نوع المستخدم والتصنيف ) وليس كلاهما ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF (:CLASS_CD_TO IS NOT NULL AND :USR_TYPE_CD_TO IS NULL) OR
 (:CLASS_CD_TO IS NULL AND :USR_TYPE_CD_TO IS NOT NULL) THEN

 STR.DISPALERT('عند إدخال أحد حقلي رمز نوع المستخدم والتصنيف يجب عدم ترك الحقل الآخر فارغاً ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END IF;

IF :FREE_TEXT IS NULL AND
 (:ACTN_TYPE_CD IN(1,2,3) OR(:ACTN_TYPE_CD = 5 AND :GLOBAL.APP_REJ <> 1))THEN

 STR.DISPALERT('يجب عدم ترك حقل التعليق فارغاً','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
-------------لا يجوز إرسال رسالة لمنشئ الرسالة-------------
IF :USER_ID_TO = :MSG_HDRS.USER_ID2 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('لا يجوز إرسال رسالة لمنشئ الرسالة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
/*
-------------لا يجوز إرسال رسالة لشخص سابق له (سجلات) لنفس الرسالة-------------
IF :ACTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_ACT_CNT
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID AND
 (
 (CLASS_CD_TO = :CLASS_CD_TO AND USR_TYPE_CD_TO = :USR_TYPE_CD_TO)
 OR (USER_ID_TO = :USER_ID_TO)
 OR (USER_ID_FROM = :USER_ID_TO));

 IF V_ACT_CNT > 0-- AND CHCK_F_OR_S_HAS_RECAL(1,NULL)= FALSE
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن إرسال أو تحويل الرسالة لمستخدم أو مجموعة لها إجراءات سابقة على نفس الرسالة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;
*/
END;

/* Query lookup data for the foreign key(s) */

 BEGIN

 CGFK$QRY_MSG_OWNERS_MO_USR_FK(
 :MSG_OWNERS.L_USR_USR_ANAME /* MOD: Value in Item :MSG_OWNERS.L_USR_USR_ANAME. */
 ,:MSG_OWNERS.PORT_CD /* IN : Value in Item :MSG_OWNERS.PORT_CD. */
 ,:MSG_OWNERS.USER_ID ); /* IN : Value in Item :MSG_OWNERS.USER_ID. */

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز مالك الرسالة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);

 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;

 IF (name_in('MSG_OWNERS.USR_TYPE_CD') IS NOT NULL AND name_in('MSG_OWNERS.DOC_TYPE') IS NOT NULL AND name_in('MSG_OWNERS.CLASS_CD') IS NOT NULL AND name_in('MSG_OWNERS.MSG_TYPE') IS NOT NULL) THEN

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Msg Owners','Msg Hdrs' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Msg Owners','Msg Hdrs' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
/*
 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;
*/
 BEGIN
/* IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;*/

 NIB.PRINT_REPORT(FN,PL_ID,V_REP_FRM_FLG,V_REP_PRNT_FLG);
 END PRINT_REPORT;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''EDI_MSG_STATUS'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('MSG_HDRS.MSG_STAT', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''EDI_MSG_IMPORTANCE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('MSG_HDRS.MSG_IMPORTANCE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''ENDORSEMENT_STATS'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('MSG_HDRS.B_ENDORSE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MFST_TYPES'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('MSG_HDRS.MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''EDI_MSG_ACTN_TYPE_CD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('MSG_ACTNS.ACTN_TYPE_CD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'MACTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'مسلسل الرسالة,م' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'USR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك,رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'USR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك,رمز المستخدم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SC_USR_CLS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز نوع المستخدم,رمز التصنيف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(
 P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Find the canvases associated with the current canvas and record which */
/* base canvas is displayed in each window */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = 'CG$SPREAD_TABLE_1') THEN
 P_CURRENT_CANVAS := 'CG$PAGE_1';
 END IF;
 /* CFLT */
 P_BASE_CANVAS := P_CURRENT_CANVAS;
 IF (get_view_property(P_CURRENT_CANVAS, WINDOW_NAME) = 'CGSO$WINDOW_1') THEN
 IF (:CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE IS NULL OR :CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE != P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 set_view_property('CG$SPREAD_TABLE_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_OFF);
 END IF;
 :CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE := P_BASE_CANVAS;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS */
PROCEDURE CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(
 P_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Current canvas */
/* Raise the current canvas, plus any dependant canvases to the top */
BEGIN
 set_view_property(P_CANVAS, VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 IF ( P_CANVAS = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 set_view_property('CG$SPREAD_TABLE_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT */
PROCEDURE CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT IS
/* Top level canvas management procedure */
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := get_item_property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255);
BEGIN
 IF ( (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS IS NULL) OR (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS != current_canvas) ) THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS := current_canvas;
 set_window_property( get_view_property( current_canvas, WINDOW_NAME ), VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 canvas_list := :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST;
 END IF;
 CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(canvas_list, current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST := canvas_list;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$TOGGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_THIS_ACTN_REPLD_OR_RECALD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--- REPLIED BY CURRENT USER OR RECALLED BY THE USER_FROM USER.
FUNCTION IS_THIS_ACTN_REPLD_OR_RECALD(P_MSG_ID VARCHAR2,P_ACTN_SEQ NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V_COUNT NUMBER;
V_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
V_CLASS_CD NUMBER;
V_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID_SUCCESSOR_FOR = P_MSG_ID
 AND ACTN_SEQ_SUCCESSOR_FOR = P_ACTN_SEQ
 AND ACTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4);

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN ----1

 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE ----1

 ----------------------
 IF :ACTN_TYPE_CD = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID = P_MSG_ID
 AND ACTN_SEQ > P_ACTN_SEQ ;

 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);


 END IF;
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);

 END IF;

 END IF;-----1
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: HAS_GRP_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION HAS_GRP_ID(P_USER_ID VARCHAR2)RETURN INTEGER IS
V_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND (MGR_ID = P_USER_ID OR
 DEPUTY_MGR_ID = P_USER_ID)
 AND GRP_STATUS = 1;


 IF V_CNT = 0 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS IG
 WHERE IG.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND IG.USER_ID = P_USER_ID
 AND IG.REC_STATUS = 1;

 IF V_CNT = 0 THEN
 RETURN(0);
 ELSE
 RETURN(1);
 END IF;


 ELSE
 RETURN(1);
 END IF;

END;

 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND (MGR_ID = V_USER_ID_FROM
 OR DEPUTY_MGR_ID = V_USER_ID_FROM)
 AND GRP_ID IN
 (
 SELECT DG.GRP_ID
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS DG
 WHERE (DG.MGR_ID = V_USER_ID_TO OR
 DG.DEPUTY_MGR_ID = V_USER_ID_TO)
 AND DG.GRP_STATUS = 1
 )
 AND GRP_STATUS = 1;

IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN


 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT1
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND (MGR_ID = V_USER_ID_FROM
 OR DEPUTY_MGR_ID = V_USER_ID_FROM)
 AND GRP_ID IN
 (
 SELECT IG.GRP_ID
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS IG
 WHERE IG.USER_ID = V_USER_ID_TO
 AND IG.REC_STATUS = 1
 )
 AND GRP_STATUS = 1;



IF V_COUNT1 = 0 THEN


 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT2
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND USER_ID = V_USER_ID_FROM
 AND GRP_ID IN
 (
 SELECT DG.GRP_ID
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS DG
 WHERE (DG.MGR_ID = V_USER_ID_TO OR
 DG.DEPUTY_MGR_ID = V_USER_ID_TO)
 AND DG.GRP_STATUS = 1
 )

 AND REC_STATUS = 1;


IF V_COUNT2 = 0 THEN


 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT3
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND USER_ID = V_USER_ID_FROM
 AND GRP_ID IN
 (
 SELECT IG.GRP_ID
 FROM INSPTR_GRPS IG
 WHERE IG.USER_ID = V_USER_ID_TO
 AND IG.REC_STATUS = 1
 )
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;



IF V_COUNT3 = 0 THEN
 RETURN(0);
ELSE
 RETURN(1);
END IF;

ELSE
 RETURN(1);
END IF;

ELSE
 RETURN(1);
END IF;

ELSE
 RETURN(1);

END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FORWARD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION FORWARD RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V_OWNER_CHECK NUMBER(3);
BEGIN
 IF :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID IS NOT NULL AND :MSG_STAT IN (1,2) THEN

-----------------------------لإظهار وظيفة تحويل لعمل اللازم---------------------------------
V_OWNER_CHECK := OWNER_CHECK(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID);

---------------OWNER
IF V_OWNER_CHECK = 1 AND CHCK_F_OR_S_HAS_RECAL(2,NULL)= TRUE THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);

---------------USER
ELSIF V_OWNER_CHECK = 2 AND :ACTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 IF (
 :USER_ID_TO = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID AND :USER_ID_TO IS NOT NULL
 )
 OR
 (
 :MSG_ACTNS.USR_TYPE_CD_TO =:PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE AND
 :MSG_ACTNS.CLASS_CD_TO =:PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD
 )
 THEN
 /*
 IF MSG REPLIED BY THE SAME USER OR RECALLED BY FROM_USER
 OR AN ACTION HAS BEEN TAKEN BY OTHER USER THAT IS FROM THE SAME CURRENT USER CLASS --> STOP
 */
 IF IS_THIS_ACTN_REPLD_OR_RECALD(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID,:MSG_ACTNS.ACTN_SEQ) THEN
 RETURN(FALSE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(TRUE);
 END IF;

 ELSE -------------:USER_FROM
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
--------------NON
ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);

END IF;
----------------------
ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EXEC_FUNS(CD VARCHAR2) IS
 V_ACTN_SEQ NUMBER(3);
 V_ACTN_MSG_ID VARCHAR2(20);
 V_USER_FROM VARCHAR2(60);
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';

BEGIN
:PARAMETER.P_FUN := 0;
 IF CD IN( 'EDIMSGSEND','EDIMSGFORWARD','EDIMSGREPLY','EDIMSGRECALL') THEN
 GO_BLOCK('MSG_ACTNS');
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('MSG_ACTNS',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 IF :ACTN_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_ACTN_MSG_ID := :MSG_ACTNS.MSG_ID;
 V_ACTN_SEQ := :ACTN_SEQ;
 V_USER_FROM := :USER_ID_FROM;
 :GLOBAL.ACT_TYPE_CD := :ACTN_TYPE_CD;
 LAST_RECORD;
 CREATE_RECORD;
 :ACTN_SEQ_SUCCESSOR_FOR := V_ACTN_SEQ;
 :MSG_ID_SUCCESSOR_FOR := V_ACTN_MSG_ID;
 END IF;

 IF CD = 'EDIMSGSEND' THEN
 :ACTN_TYPE_CD := 1;
 IF OWNER_CHECK(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID)= 1 THEN
 :ACTN_SEQ_SUCCESSOR_FOR := NULL;
 :MSG_ID_SUCCESSOR_FOR := NULL;
 END IF;

 ELSIF CD = 'EDIMSGFORWARD' THEN
 :ACTN_TYPE_CD := 2;
 IF OWNER_CHECK(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID)= 1 THEN
 :ACTN_SEQ_SUCCESSOR_FOR := NULL;
 :MSG_ID_SUCCESSOR_FOR := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSIF CD = 'EDIMSGREPLY' THEN
 :ACTN_TYPE_CD := 3;
 :USER_ID_TO := V_USER_FROM;
 ELSE
 :ACTN_TYPE_CD := 4;
 :USER_ID_TO := :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 :USER_ID_FROM := :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;

 END IF;

 :USER_ID_FROM := :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 :MSG_ACTNS.L_USR_USR_ANAME := :PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME;
----------------------------------------------------
 IF CD IN ('EDIMSGREPLY','EDIMSGRECALL') THEN
 GO_ITEM('FREE_TEXT');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('USER_ID_TO',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('USR_TYPE_CD_TO',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CLASS_CD_TO',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 /* ELSE
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('USER_ID_TO',ENABLED) = 'FALSE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('USER_ID_TO',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('USR_TYPE_CD_TO',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CLASS_CD_TO',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
*/
 END IF;
----------------------------------------------------
 ELSIF CD IN( 'EDIMSGDTLS') THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_UNDER_FUN := 0;
 SELECT COUNT(MSG_ID)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM MSG_DTLS
 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID;

 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 GO_BLOCK('MSG_HDRS');
 :PARAMETER.P_UNDER_FUN := 0;
 STR.DISPALERT('لا توجد تفاصيل للرسالة الحالية','ERROR');
 ELSE
 LOV_MSG_DTLS;
 END IF;

----------------------------------------------------
 ELSIF CD IN ('EDIMSGAPPROVE','EDIMSGREJECT') THEN
------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM MSG_DTLS
 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID;

 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID
 AND ACTN_TYPE_CD = 6
 AND USER_ID_FROM = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;

 IF V_CNT <= 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لم يتم اسعراض تفاصيل الرسالة,الرجاء استعراض تفاصيل الرسالة أولاً','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF; ------------------------------------------------------
 GO_BLOCK('MSG_ACTNS');
 LAST_RECORD;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('MSG_ACTNS',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 IF :ACTN_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND :USER_ID_FROM IS NOT NULL THEN CREATE_RECORD; END IF;
/*ENDORSE*/ IF :B_ENDORSE = 1 THEN
 :ACTN_TYPE_CD := 7 ;
 :USER_ID_FROM := :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 CREATE_RECORD;
 END IF;
 GO_ITEM('FREE_TEXT');
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'MSG_ACTNS.FREE_TEXT';
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('USER_ID_TO',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CLASS_CD_TO',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('USR_TYPE_CD_TO',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'MSG_ACTNS.FREE_TEXT';

 :ACTN_TYPE_CD := 5 ;
 :USER_ID_FROM := :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID;
 --CREATE_RECORD;
 IF CD = 'EDIMSGREJECT' THEN
 :GLOBAL.APP_REJ := 0 ;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.APP_REJ := 1 ;
 END IF;

-----------------------------------------------------
 ELSIF CD = 'EDIMSGREJINFRM' THEN
 :MSG_STAT := 5;
 ELSIF CD = 'EDIMSGAPPINFRM' THEN
 :MSG_STAT := 6;
 ELSIF CD = 'EDIMSGREQUEST' THEN
 :MSG_STAT := 7;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RESPONSE_FREE_TEXT',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RESPONSE_FREE_TEXT',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RESPONSE_FREE_TEXT',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :GLOBAL.EDIMSGREQ := 1;
 GO_ITEM('RESPONSE_FREE_TEXT');
 ELSIF CD = 'EDIMSGCANCEL' THEN
 BEGIN

 RET := STR.DispAlert('هل تريد بالفعل إلغاء الرسالة!؟','WARNING');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 :MSG_STAT := 8;
 :MSG_HDRS.NEW_MSG_ID:=EDI_GNRL.GET_NEXT_MESSAGE_ID(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 COMMIT;
 ELSIF RET = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END;

 END IF;

---========= FOR NEW MSG STRG

 IF CD = 'EDIMSG_DAYS_NBR' THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 :GLOBAL.ADJ_FUN_CD := CD;
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCLTN_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_MSG_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER,:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;


 END IF;

--=================

 IF CD IN( 'EDIMSGDTLS', 'EDIMSG_DAYS_NBR' ) THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_UNDER_FUN := 0;
 ELSIF CD NOT IN( 'MOD_CALL_BACK') THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_UNDER_FUN := 1;
 :PARAMETER.P_FUN :=1 ;
 TMPLT.DISABLE_ALL_FUNS;

 END IF;

---------

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_FIELDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISP_FIELDS(V_CLR BOOLEAN) IS
 cur_itm VARCHAR2(80);
 cur_itm_FULL VARCHAR2(80);
 cur_block VARCHAR2(80):=:System.Cursor_Block;
 V_HINT_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
cur_itm:=Get_Block_Property(cur_block,FIRST_ITEM );
WHILE(cur_itm IS NOT NULL ) LOOP
cur_itm_FULL :=cur_block||'.'||cur_itm;

 IF :DOC_TYPE2 ='DEC' AND CUR_ITM IN('DCLTN_NBR','DCLTN_DT','L_DCLTNT_TYPE_NAME') THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(TRUE,cur_itm_FULL);

 ELSIF :DOC_TYPE2 ='DEO' AND CUR_ITM IN('DO_ISS_DT','DO_NBR','SHPG_AGNT_NBR','SHPNG_AGNT_NAME' ) THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(TRUE,cur_itm_FULL);

 ELSIF :DOC_TYPE2 = 'MAF' AND CUR_ITM IN('MFST_DT','MFST_NBR','MFST_TYPE','VSSLMFST_PORT_CD','B_PORT','PORT_NAME','B_ENDORSE') THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(TRUE,cur_itm_FULL);


 ELSIF :DOC_TYPE2 = 'EXM' AND CUR_ITM IN('DECREE_NBR','DECREE_DT','DECREE_EFF_DT','DECREE_EXPRY_DT') THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(TRUE,cur_itm_FULL);

 ELSIF :DOC_TYPE2 = 'SDC' AND CUR_ITM IN('STATS_NBR','STATS_TYPE_NAME','STATS_DT') THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(TRUE,cur_itm_FULL);

 ELSIF CUR_ITM IN('DCLTN_NBR','DCLTN_DT','L_DCLTNT_TYPE_NAME', 'DO_ISS_DT','DO_NBR','SHPG_AGNT_NBR','MFST_DT',
 'MFST_NBR','MFST_TYPE','VSSLMFST_PORT_CD','B_PORT','PORT_NAME','SHPNG_AGNT_NAME',
 'DECREE_NBR','DECREE_DT','DECREE_EFF_DT','DECREE_EXPRY_DT',
 'STATS_NBR','STATS_TYPE_NAME','STATS_DT','B_ENDORSE'
 ) THEN
 SHOW_ITEM(FALSE,cur_itm_FULL);

 END IF;
 cur_itm := Get_Item_Property(cur_itm_FULL,NEXTITEM);
END LOOP;
---------------------------------------CLEAR FIELDS------------------------------------------
IF V_CLR = TRUE THEN
 :DCLTN_NBR := NULL;
 :DCLTN_DT := NULL;
 :L_DCLTNT_TYPE_NAME:= NULL;
 :MFST_DT := NULL;
 :MFST_NBR := NULL;
 :MFST_TYPE := NULL;
 :VSSLMFST_PORT_CD := NULL;
 :DO_ISS_DT := NULL;
 :DO_NBR := NULL;
 :SHPG_AGNT_NBR := NULL;
 :SHPNG_AGNT_NAME := NULL;
 :DECREE_PORT_CD := NULL;
 :DECREE_ISN := NULL;
 :STATS_NBR := NULL;
 :STATS_TYPE_NAME := NULL;
 :STATS_DT := NULL;
 :B_ENDORSE := NULL;

END IF;


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_REPLY_FOR_FRWRD_ACTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_REPLY_FOR_FRWRD_ACTN(P_MSG_ID VARCHAR2,P_ACTN_SEQ INTEGER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT MSG_ID,ACTN_SEQ,USER_ID_TO,CLASS_CD_TO,USR_TYPE_CD_TO
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID_SUCCESSOR_FOR = P_MSG_ID AND
 ACTN_SEQ_SUCCESSOR_FOR = P_ACTN_SEQ AND
 ACTN_TYPE_CD = 2 AND
 USER_ID_FROM = :USER_ID_TO ;

 V_HAS_FWD_MSG BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN

 FOR I IN C
 LOOP

 V_HAS_FWD_MSG := FALSE;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID_SUCCESSOR_FOR = I.MSG_ID
 AND ACTN_SEQ_SUCCESSOR_FOR = I.ACTN_SEQ

 AND (
 USER_ID_FROM = I.USER_ID_TO
 OR
 ((I.CLASS_CD_TO,I.USR_TYPE_CD_TO) IN
 (SELECT CLASS_CD,USR_TYPE_CD
 FROM SC_USERS
 WHERE USER_ID = USER_ID_FROM)))

 AND ACTN_TYPE_CD IN(3,4) ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);

 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF V_HAS_FWD_MSG = TRUE THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_REPLY_FRWRD_MSGS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_REPLY_FRWRD_MSGS(P_MSG_ID VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT ACTN_SEQ
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID
 AND ACTN_TYPE_CD = 2 ;

 V_HAS_ACTIONS BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_HAS_FWD_MSG BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN



 FOR I IN C
 LOOP
 V_HAS_ACTIONS := TRUE;
 V_HAS_FWD_MSG := TRUE;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID_SUCCESSOR_FOR = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID
 AND ACTN_SEQ_SUCCESSOR_FOR = I.ACTN_SEQ
 AND ACTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4);

 IF V_COUNT = 0 THEN
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 END LOOP;


 IF V_HAS_ACTIONS = TRUE THEN
 IF V_HAS_FWD_MSG = FALSE THEN
 RETURN(FALSE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(TRUE);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RETURN(TRUE);
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHCK_F_OR_S_HAS_RECAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHCK_F_OR_S_HAS_RECAL(P_ACT_TYPE NUMBER,P_RECALL_SEQ NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT ACTN_SEQ , ACTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID
 AND (ACTN_SEQ = P_RECALL_SEQ OR P_RECALL_SEQ IS NULL)
 AND USER_ID_FROM = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND ACTN_TYPE_CD <> 4 ;

 V_HAS_ACTIONS BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_DATA_FOUND BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;

BEGIN
 FOR I IN C
 LOOP
 IF ( I.ACTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND P_ACT_TYPE = 1 )
 OR (I.ACTN_TYPE_CD = 1 AND P_ACT_TYPE = 2)THEN
 V_DATA_FOUND := TRUE;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM MSG_ACTNS
 WHERE MSG_ID_SUCCESSOR_FOR = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID
 AND ACTN_SEQ_SUCCESSOR_FOR = I.ACTN_SEQ
 AND ACTN_TYPE_CD = 4;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 V_HAS_ACTIONS := TRUE;
 ELSE
 V_HAS_ACTIONS := FALSE;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF V_DATA_FOUND = FALSE THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 IF V_HAS_ACTIONS = TRUE THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE

 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_FUNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_FUNS IS
V_CHECK1 BOOLEAN;
V_CHECK2 BOOLEAN;
V_CHECK3 BOOLEAN;
V_CHECK4 NUMBER;
V_CHECK5 BOOLEAN;
V_COUNT NUMBER(3);
V_CNT_MSG NUMBER;

BEGIN
TMPLT.DISABLE_ALL_FUNS;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF :PARAMETER.P_UNDER_FUN = 1 THEN

 RETURN;
END IF;

------------------------------------
--IF :MSG_STAT not in ( 8 ,3,4,7) AND :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID IS NOT NULL THEN

-------------------------------- لإظهار الوظائف ---------------------------
IF :USER_ID2 <> :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID THEN
IF :PARAMETER.P_LEVEL = 2 THEN

 IF FORWARD THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGFORWARD');
 END IF;
--
 IF SEND THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGSEND');
 END IF;
--
 IF REPLY THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGREPLY');
 END IF;
--
 IF RECALL THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGRECALL');
 END IF;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_LEVEL = 1 AND :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGDTLS');
 END IF;

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
V_CHECK4 := OWNER_CHECK(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID);

 IF V_CHECK4 = 1 AND :MSG_STAT IN (1,2,7) AND
 CHECK_REPLY_FRWRD_MSGS(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID)
 AND CHCK_F_OR_S_HAS_RECAL(2,NULL)
 THEN

 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGAPPROVE');
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGREJECT');

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT_MSG
 FROM DCLTN_STRG_EXMTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN
 AND MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID
 ;
 IF :MSG_TYPE2 = 'STRREQ' AND V_CNT_MSG = 0 THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSG_DAYS_NBR');
 TMPLT.DISABLE_FUN('EDIMSGAPPROVE');

 END IF;
 IF V_CNT_MSG > 0 THEN
 TMPLT.DISABLE_FUN('EDIMSGREJECT');
 END IF;
 IF :MSG_STAT IN (1,2) THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGREQUEST');
 END IF;

 END IF;

-----------------------------------

END IF;
---===============NEW MSG FOR STRG==============
---===============NEW MSG FOR STRG==============


END;


 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
/*IF :MSG_HDRS.USER_ID2 = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID AND :MSG_STAT IN (3,4) THEN
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGREJINFRM');
 TMPLT.ENABLE_FUN('EDIMSGAPPINFRM');
END IF;
*/

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_FIELDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADJ_FIELDS IS
cur_itm VARCHAR2(80);
cur_itm_FULL VARCHAR2(80);
cur_block VARCHAR2(80):=:System.Cursor_Block;
V_HINT_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
-------------------------------------SETING PROMPTS,WIDTHS & POSITIONS-------------------------------------
cur_itm:=Get_Block_Property(cur_block,FIRST_ITEM );
WHILE(cur_itm IS NOT NULL ) LOOP
cur_itm_FULL :=cur_block||'.'||cur_itm;
 IF CUR_ITM IN('DCLTN_NBR','L_DCLTNT_TYPE_NAME','DCLTN_DT',
 'MFST_DT','MFST_NBR','MFST_TYPE',
 'VSSLMFST_PORT_CD','DO_ISS_DT','DO_NBR','SHPG_AGNT_NBR',
 'SHPNG_AGNT_NAME','B_PORT','PORT_NAME',
 'DECREE_NBR','DECREE_DT','DECREE_EFF_DT','DECREE_EXPRY_DT',
 'STATS_NBR','STATS_TYPE_NAME','STATS_DT'
 ) THEN

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,1.5);
 V_HINT_TXT := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,HINT_TEXT);
 V_HINT_TXT := REPLACE(V_HINT_TXT,' - list of values available','');
 V_HINT_TXT := V_HINT_TXT||' ';
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,PROMPT_TEXT,V_HINT_TXT);

 IF CUR_ITM = 'DCLTN_NBR' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,1.86);

 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'DCLTN_DT' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,3.90,1.86);
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'L_DCLTNT_TYPE_NAME' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,2.1);

 ---------------------------------------------
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'STATS_NBR' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,1.86);

 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'STATS_DT' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,3.90,1.86);
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'STATS_TYPE_NAME' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,2.1);

 ---------------------------------------------
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'MFST_NBR' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,1.86);
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'MFST_DT' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,3.90,1.86);
 /* ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'B_ENDORSE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,1);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,6.5,1.86);
*/
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'MFST_TYPE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,2.1);

 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'VSSLMFST_PORT_CD' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,0.4);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,3.90,2.1);

 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'B_PORT' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,0.2);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,4.3,2.1);

 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'PORT_NAME' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,2);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,4.5,2.1);

 V_HINT_TXT := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,HINT_TEXT);
 V_HINT_TXT := REPLACE(V_HINT_TXT,'Enter value for ',' ');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,PROMPT_TEXT,V_HINT_TXT);
 ---------------------------------------
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'DO_NBR' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,1.86);
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'DO_ISS_DT' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,3.90,1.86);
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'SHPG_AGNT_NBR' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,0.5);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,2.11);
 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'SHPNG_AGNT_NAME' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,2.1);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.81,2.11);
 V_HINT_TXT := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,HINT_TEXT);
 V_HINT_TXT := REPLACE(V_HINT_TXT,'Enter value for ',' ');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,PROMPT_TEXT,V_HINT_TXT);
 ----------------------------------------
ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'DECREE_NBR' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,1);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,1.86);

 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'DECREE_DT' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,1);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,3.90,1.86);

 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'DECREE_EFF_DT' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,1);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,1.3,2.11);

 ELSIF CUR_ITM = 'DECREE_EXPRY_DT' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,WIDTH,1);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,POSITION,3.90,2.11);
 END IF;
------------------------------------------
 END IF;
 cur_itm := Get_Item_Property(cur_itm_FULL,NEXTITEM);
END LOOP;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('B_ENDORSE',WIDTH,1);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('B_ENDORSE',POSITION,6.5,1.86);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_MGR_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADD_MGR_ID IS
V_COUNT NUMBER;
V_OWNER_SEQ NUMBER;
V_GRP_ID NUMBER;
V_MGR_ID VARCHAR2(200);
V_DEPUTY_MGR_ID VARCHAR2(200);
MSG_LVL VARCHAR2(5);
BEGIN

BEGIN
 SELECT GRP_ID
 INTO V_GRP_ID
 FROM STATS_DCLTNS
 WHERE
 PORT_CD = :MSG_HDRS.PORT_CD AND
 STATS_ISN = :MSG_HDRS.STATS_ISN;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;


BEGIN
 SELECT MGR_ID , DEPUTY_MGR_ID
 INTO V_MGR_ID , V_DEPUTY_MGR_ID
 FROM DCLTN_GRPS
 WHERE
 PORT_CD = :MSG_HDRS.PORT_CD AND
 GRP_ID = V_GRP_ID;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;

---------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SELECT 1 INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE
:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID IN (V_MGR_ID , V_DEPUTY_MGR_ID) AND NOT EXISTS
(SELECT 1 FROM MSG_OWNERS WHERE MSG_ID = :MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID AND USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;

IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
---------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
V_OWNER_SEQ := EDI_GNRL.GET_MAX_SEQ_OWNERS(:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID);

MSG_LVL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25';

INSERT INTO MSG_OWNERS(MSG_ID,OWNER_SEQ,USER_ID,PORT_CD,DOC_TYPE,MSG_TYPE)
VALUES (:MSG_HDRS.MSG_ID,V_OWNER_SEQ,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,:MSG_HDRS.PORT_CD,:MSG_HDRS.DOC_TYPE2,:MSG_HDRS.MSG_TYPE2);

FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');

:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := MSG_LVL;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;

END IF;
END;

/* CGGN$GET_DATE_AND_USER */
/* Get the current user and date; store in items for general use */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT SYSDATE, USER
 FROM SYS.DUAL;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO :PARAMETER.CGU$SYSDATE, :PARAMETER.CGU$USER;

 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(3, 'No row in table <p1>', 'SYS.DUAL' ), 'F', 'OFG', 3);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

IF CHECK_EDI_MSG_TIMER = TRUE THEN

 IF (V_VAR_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN IS NOT NULL) AND

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('RETURN_EDI_MSG');

 END;

 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(TIMER_ID) THEN
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER', 1, REPEAT);
 END;
 */

 NIB.ON_ERROR;

Trigger.Name: KEY-F9
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
 VIS VARCHAR2(200);
 V_FUN VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 VIS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE);
 V_FUN := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FUN_BUT',VISIBLE);

 IF VIS = 'TRUE' THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ELSE
 IF V_FUN = 'TRUE' THEN

 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');

 TMPLT.Populate_Functions;
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := TRUE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 1;
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

DECLARE
 timer_id VARCHAR2(20) := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(TIMER_NAME);

BEGIN
IF timer_id IN ('OWNERS_Q','OWNERS_Q2') THEN
 GO_BLOCK('MSG_OWNERS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 --Delete_Timer(timer_id);
 IF timer_id =('OWNERS_Q') THEN
 GO_BLOCK('MSG_ACTNS');
 ELSE
 GO_BLOCK('MSG_HDRS');
 END IF;
END IF;


IF timer_id =('LOV_MSG_Q') THEN
IF :GLOBAL.MSGID <> 0 THEN
 GO_BLOCK('MSG_HDRS');
 :PARAMETER.P_MSG_ID:=:GLOBAL.MSGID;
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :GLOBAL.MSGID := 0;
END IF;

END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CLEAR-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_CLEAR_DETAILS */
/* clear all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 IF (FORM_FAILURE AND :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION IN ('MOUSE', 'DUPLICATE_RECORD')) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) THEN
 CGBS$.CLEAR_MASTER_DETAIL( :SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK, :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION );
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_POPULATE_DETAILS */
/* query all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.QUERY_DETAILS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CQUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CQUERY_FRM */
/* Check if query is allowed to avoid unnecessary coordination */
BEGIN
 IF (get_block_property( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'FALSE') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(37, 'Query not allowed in this block'), 'E', 'OFG', 37);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CGBS$.DO_KEYQRY( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, 'COUNT_QUERY', :SYSTEM.MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CLRREC */
/* Avoid clearing details if current row is new and invalid */
BEGIN
 IF ( CGBS2$.IS_RECORD_DIRTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED' OR CGBS2$.IS_COMMIT_NEEDED( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK ) ) THEN
 CGBS2$.DO_COMMIT_DIALOGUE;
 END IF;
 clear_record;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTKEY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$DISABLE_NXTKEY */
/* Disable KEY-NXTKEY for the whole form */
BEGIN

 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE_QUERY_MODE */
/* This changes the mode of block synchronization so that if it is */
/* currently ON, then it is changed to OFF, and vice-versa. */
/* It also queries the dependent blocks as appropriate for the */
/* new mode. */
BEGIN
 CGBS$TOGGLE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGGN$KEY_CLRFRM */
/* Perform the key's standard functionality */
BEGIN

 IF :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'CHANGED' THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

BEGIN
 BEGIN

END;
